films.title: Two-Lane Blacktop
films.overview: A driver and mechanic drag racing for money cross paths with a female hitchhiker and a drifter who challenges them to a cross-country race.

films.title: Cockfighter
films.overview: A man who trains fighting cocks vows to remain silent until one of his birds wins a championship.

films.title: Beast from Haunted Cave
films.overview: A gold thief and his gang use a skier's lodge and meet a monster covered with cobwebs.

films.title: Trapped Ashes
films.overview: Trapped in a house of horror, seven people discover that the only way they'll get out alive is to tell their scariest stories.

films.title: Ride in the Whirlwind
films.overview: Three cowboys, mistaken for members of an outlaw gang, are relentlessly pursued by a posse.

films.title: The Shooting
films.overview: Two miners agree to guide a mysterious woman, who has appeared in their camp from nowhere, to a nearby town; but soon, because of her erratic behavior, they begin to suspect that her true purpose is quite different.

films.title: Silent Night, Deadly Night III: Better Watch Out!
films.overview: Ricky Caldwell, the notorious 'Killer Santa Claus', awakens from a six-year coma after being kept alive on life-support by a slightly crazed doctor experimenting with ESP and other special abilities. Ricky targets a young, clairvoyant blind woman, named Laura, whom is traveling with her brother Chris, and his girlfriend Jerri to their grandmother's house for Christmas Eve, and Ricky decides to go after her, leaving a trail of dead bodies in his wake.
